WeaponTraitDef.label: suppressor
WeaponTraitDef.description: A muzzle-mounted suppressor that reduces the sound and flash produced when firing, making hunted animals less likely to retaliate.

WeaponTraitDef.label: compensator
WeaponTraitDef.description: A muzzle-mounted recoil compensator. It vents gas to reduce recoil and improve accuracy at close to medium range.
